holder: King CHARLES III; represented by Governor General Mary SIMON (since 26 July 2021)
published: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor General Mary SIMON (since 26 July 2021)
process: the monarchy is hereditary; governor general appointed by the monarch on the advice of the prime minister for a 5-year term; after legislative elections, the governor general usually designates the leader of the majority party or majority coalition in the House of Commons as prime minister
governmentType: federal parliamentary democracy (Parliament of Canada) under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm; federal and state authorities and responsibilities regulated in constitution
cabinet: Federal Ministry chosen by the prime minister usually from among members of his/her own party sitting in Parliament
